title: Azole resistance associated regulatory motifs within the promoter of cyp51A in Aspergillus fumigatus
authors: Kühbacher A; Peiffer M; Hortschansky P; Merschak P; Bromley MJ; Haas H; Brakhage AA; Gsaller F
one_liner_zh: 该文通过启动子突变和蛋白/DNA互作分析研究烟曲霉cyp51A启动子中转录因子结合基序对唑类耐药的作用，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但以湿实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Aspergillus fumigatus is one of the deadliest fungal species causing hundreds of thousands of deaths each year. As azoles provide the preferred first-line option for treatment of Aspergillosis, the increase in rates of resistance and the poor therapeutic outcomes for those infected with a resistant isolate constitutes a serious global health threat. Azole resistance is frequently associated with specific tandem repeat duplications of a promoter element upstream of cyp51A , the gene which encodes the target for this drug class in A. fumigatus . This promoter element is recognized by the activating transcription factors SrbA and AtrR. This region also provides a docking platform for the CCAAT-binding-complex (CBC) and HapX that cooperate in the regulation of genes involved in iron-consuming pathways including cyp51A . Here, we studied the regulatory contribution of SrbA, AtrR, CBC and HapX binding sites on cyp51A expression and azole resistance during different iron availability employing promoter mutational analysis and protein/DNA interaction analysis. This strategy revealed iron status-dependent and -independent roles of these regulatory elements. We show that promoter occupation by both AtrR and SrbA is required for iron-independent steady-state transcriptional activation of cyp51A and its induction during short-term iron exposure relies on HapX binding. We further uncover the HapX binding site as repressor element the disruption of which elevates cyp51A expression and azole resistance regardless of iron availability.
abstract_zh: 烟曲霉（Aspergillus fumigatus）是最致命的真菌物种之一，每年导致数十万人死亡。由于唑类药物是治疗曲霉病的首选一线方案，耐药率的上升以及感染耐药菌株患者的不良治疗结果构成了严重的全球健康威胁。唑类耐药通常与cyp51A上游启动子元件的特定串联重复扩增相关，cyp51A是编码该类药物在烟曲霉中靶标的基因。该启动子元件被激活转录因子SrbA和AtrR识别。此区域还为CCAAT结合复合物（CBC）和HapX提供对接平台，这些因子协同调控涉及铁消耗途径的基因，包括cyp51A。在本研究中，我们通过启动子突变分析和蛋白质/DNA相互作用分析，探讨了SrbA、AtrR、CBC和HapX结合位点在不同铁可用性条件下对cyp51A表达和唑类耐药的调控贡献。该策略揭示了这些调控元件在铁状态依赖性和非依赖性中的作用。我们表明，AtrR和SrbA对启动子的占据是cyp51A铁非依赖性稳态转录激活所必需的，而其在短期铁暴露期间的诱导依赖于HapX结合。我们进一步发现HapX结合位点作为抑制元件，其破坏会提高cyp51A表达和唑类耐药性，且不受铁可用性影响。
